chapter: Chicago memories and the road to the Navy
title: Who was in Fate Marable's band when Zutty joined
summary: Zutty lists Sidney Desvignes and Amos White on trumpets, a trombonist named Brashear, three saxes, bass, banjo and a Paducah violinist, with Loving Good later added as second pianist.
